title: TMC: Form Spam Protection
note: The Matting Company custom code. Hidden honeypot + 3 second time-trap on every Elementor form.

title: TMC: Mat and Accessory Content
note: Shortcodes that print mat and accessory data (specs, galleries, references, downloads, cards, breadcrumbs). Used in the Theme Builder templates. Data comes from the ACF groups Mat Details and Accessory Details.

title: TMC: Content Styles
note: Styles for the HTML printed by the TMC shortcodes (spec table, galleries, downloads, cards, breadcrumbs, rich text). Uses the Elementor global variables.

title: TMC: Mat Finder
note: Mat Finder page: shows the mats whose Mat Finder category (ACF) contains the clicked letter A-F. Results go into the element with the class tmc-finder-results.

title: TMC: Technical Table
note: Technical Information page: filterable table of mats (type, height) from the ACF Mat Details fields. Output goes into the element with the class tmc-tech-results.

title: TMC: Site Guide
note: Read-only Site Guide page: the teal item at the top of the admin menu. Shows where things are managed, templates, snippets and status checks.
